purpose: Teach: セキュリティー/書き込む/宝くじ/猛烈/若しくは/つかみ/近々/なんだかんだ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のセキュリティーシステムを更新したいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I've been thinking we should update the store's security system.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Soft opening — not urgent. Looking at her directly but not pressing. Gentle hands. The tone of someone turning an idea over before sharing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ノートに何やら書き込むのが習慣だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of our regulars has this habit of jotting things down in a notebook every time they come in.
lines.style: Observant, warm curiosity. Not gossiping — noticing. Light, conversational rhythm. Slight smile in the voice like she's sharing something charming she's picked up on.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、宝くじが当たったらお店を開きたいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer mentioned they'd open their own place if they won the lottery.
lines.style: Gentle, wistful quality. Knowing nod in the voice — recognizing that quiet dream. Slower on the second half, letting the thought breathe.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、夏は猛烈に暑くて売り上げが落ちるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The summers are brutal for us — the heat always kills the sales.
lines.style: Slight sigh underneath. Realistic, matter-of-fact but not defeated. Lean into the problem without dramatizing it. Steady, grounded tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、コーヒー若しくは紅茶、お客様にお選びいただこうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Why don't we let customers choose — coffee or tea today?
lines.style: Lighter energy here. Gentle suggestion, not directive. Slight rise at the question. Collaborative, like inviting her into the idea rather than announcing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の心をつかみたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I want to make sure we're really connecting with our customers.
lines.style: Warm, sincere, slightly vulnerable. Lean into the word 'connecting'. Not rushed. The tone of someone who cares about the quality of the moments, not just the transaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、近々、新メニューを発表したいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm thinking of announcing a new menu soon — what do you think?
lines.style: Lighter, more animated than before. Genuine excitement underneath but not overplaying it. Forward-leaning, inviting her response. Warm anticipation in the pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、なんだかんだで今日も忙しかったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, even with everything going on, today was a good day — we stayed busy.
lines.style: Soft, reflective exhale. Quiet satisfaction. Slow, slightly trailing ending like she's taking a moment to settle into the realization. Small, genuine smile audible.
